summary: round 2, delta since 529fb4b: F-1, F-2, F-3, F-4, F-5, F-6 fixed (minors F-7 to F-18 and info F-20 also addressed). One new major on a changed line: REQ-A11Y-010 AC-4 now bans any artificial red state, which conflicts with the tests-red-first gate the web-qa tests node carried in CHG-0001 and needs a human decision (F-21). Two new minors (F-22, F-23) and one new info (F-24) are follow-ups; info F-19 carried.

findings.message: REQ-A11Y-001 AC-4 (session ended) must run under the main configuration (REQ-A11Y-010 AC-1), which has no test clock (docs/specs/CHG-0001/sdd.md:L613-L620); the state is reachable by a signed-in user whose next request gets 401 (web/src/auth/SessionProvider.tsx:L61-L67), for example after the session cookie is removed.
findings.suggestion: No change needed; the SDD can name how the state is reached.

findings.message: REQ-A11Y-010 AC-4 and analyst default 11 now forbid any stub or artificial failing state and expect tests that pass on their first run against develop (REQ-A11Y-012 AC-4 is the expected outcome). The request settles that the tests are written test-first by web-qa (clarifications.md:L4-L5), and in CHG-0001 the web-qa tests node carried the tests-red-first gate (.harness/changes/CHG-0001/plan.json, N08-tests-web gates critic-verdict and tests-red-first). If this change gets the same node, an honest all-green first run cannot give it a red commit, and AC-4 forbids making one, so the node could not complete. Nothing in Q1-Q10 settles this; it needs the requester or approver. I could not confirm how the gate evaluates (its code is out of my reach), so this is the conflict as the plans show it.
findings.suggestion: Raise an open question to the approver: how test-first is evidenced in an audit-only change (for example the tests node runs without the tests-red-first gate, or the gate is waived by the approver with a reason), record the answer, and reference it from AC-4 and analyst default 11 (L236).

findings.message: REQ-A11Y-010 AC-4 routes every test that fails on its first run to REQ-A11Y-012, but REQ-A11Y-012 defines only a real WCAG failure (AC-1) and a spec-wording difference (AC-5). A first-run failure caused by a defect in the test itself, or by test support not yet in place (for example video not yet switched on for the REQ-A11Y-008 test), has no class. Rated minor, unlike round 1 F-1: the spec no longer asserts anything known to fail on develop, and fixing a defective test is not weakening it under AC-5.
findings.suggestion: Say that a first-run failure caused by the test or its support is fixed in the test and recorded in the summary as such, and that the playwright.config.ts change of AC-3 lands in the test commit; only a failure of the app goes to REQ-A11Y-012.

findings.message: REQ-A11Y-012 AC-5 reads as a standing rule: any difference between spec or Q10 wording and the app that is not a WCAG failure is checked against the app and does not block the merge; the listed defaults (1, 2, 3, 6) read as examples. A difference found after freeze would then be settled by the test author rather than the approver (harness contract item 2: stop and report). The glossary at L27-L28 is limited to defaults 1 and 2, so the two places also differ in scope.
findings.suggestion: Limit AC-5 to the differences listed in analyst defaults 1, 2, 3 and 6, and say that any other difference found later is reported for the approver before the test is adapted.

findings.message: REQ-A11Y-010 AC-3 (analyst default 10) adds no devDependency, while REQ-A11Y-009 AC-2 computes per-pixel luminance from screenshots, which needs a PNG decode. That fits Q8 (a) (no new tool) and can be done in the page (canvas) or with what Playwright already provides.
findings.suggestion: No change needed; the SDD should name how screenshots are decoded without a new dependency.
